Info.description: Microscopy Image Browser (MIB) is a free, open-source MATLAB-based software designed for efficient processing, segmentation, and visualization of multidimensional (2D–4D) light and electron microscopy datasets. It provides user-friendly tools for handling large, complex data, enabling quantitative analysis of cellular and tissue morphology. With support for customization and plug-ins, MIB helps researchers fully exploit advanced imaging techniques for studying cellular structures in their natural context.
